almanac.raft.gear.armour.text:
# Shell Armour
Made from seashells: 13 armour points in all (between chainmail and iron) and a little toughness. Wear all four pieces for Resistance I while in water.
# Explorer's Outfit
Hat, Jacket, Trousers and Boots made from sail canvas: 7 armour points, like leather. The full outfit lets you walk 10% faster and gives Luck I for better fishing and loot.
almanac.raft.gear.armour.title: Armour
almanac.raft.gear.fishing.text:
# Driftwood Fishing Rod
Made from 3 driftwood planks and 2 string. It lasts twice as long as a plain rod and has its own tackle box: one slot for Fish Bait and one for Golden Lures.
* Sneak-use the rod to open the tackle box.
* Or, in your inventory, right-click bait or lures onto the rod. Right-click the rod with an empty hand to take them out.
* The tooltip shows what is loaded.
Every cast uses one bait and one lure, if loaded, on top of the rod's enchantments. It only uses what is loaded, never bait from your bag.
---
# Bait and lures
* Fish Bait: bites come 5 seconds sooner, like Lure I.
* Golden Lure: better treasure, like Luck of the Sea II, and bites come 5 seconds sooner.
With a plain fishing rod, keep bait or a lure in your off hand or bag: each cast uses one.
In a Fish Trap, bait or a lure makes it catch twice as fast.
almanac.raft.gear.fishing.title: Fishing
almanac.raft.gear.text:
# Weapons
* Shark Tooth Spear: a stick and a shark tooth. Jab or charge like any spear; as strong as an iron spear, with 320 uses.
* Driftwood Boomerang: right-click to throw. It flies about 18 blocks, hits for 5, then comes back to you, even through walls. On the way it picks up to 3 stacks of floating items. 200 throws.
* Machete: 5.5 damage and quick swings. It cuts leaves, plants, bamboo, vines and crops in a blink. 280 uses.
almanac.raft.gear.title: Gear & Gadgets
almanac.raft.gear.tools.text:
# Wreck Compass
Right-click and the needle turns to the nearest shipwreck within about 1000 blocks: galleons, cargo ships, fishing boats, sunken planes and overworld shipwrecks. It also tells you how far it is. Once every 5 seconds.
# Captain's Spyglass
Zooms twice as far as a spyglass and shows the distance to what you look at.
# Bait
Fish Bait: 4 from kelp and rotten flesh, a spider eye, a crab claw or a cod. Bites come 5 seconds sooner, like Lure I.
Golden Lure: bait and 3 gold nuggets. Better treasure, like Luck of the Sea II, and bites come sooner too.

jei.raft.info.driftwood_fishing_rod: A fishing rod with its own tackle box: one slot for Fish Bait, one for Golden Lures. Sneak-use the rod to open it, or right-click bait and lures onto the rod in your inventory (right-click it with an empty hand to take them out). Every cast uses one of each that is loaded, on top of the rod's own enchantments; it never takes bait from your bag. 128 uses, repaired with driftwood planks.
jei.raft.info.fish_bait: Fish Bait makes fish bite 5 seconds sooner, like Lure I. With a plain fishing rod keep it in your off hand or bag: each cast uses one. Or load a stack into a Driftwood Fishing Rod. In a Fish Trap it makes the trap twice as fast.
jei.raft.info.fishing_rod: Beach Craft: keep Fish Bait or a Golden Lure in your off hand or bag and every cast uses one (faster bites; the lure also brings better treasure). The Driftwood Fishing Rod carries its own bait instead.
jei.raft.info.golden_lure: The Golden Lure brings better treasure, like Luck of the Sea II, and bites 5 seconds sooner. With a plain rod it is used from your off hand or bag, one per cast; a Driftwood Fishing Rod holds a stack of them in its own slot.
